nodes: b>TR-001 Approve a PRD for a release (never delegated)

b>TR-005 State a domain fact, figure, regulation or citation as true (never delegated)
b>TR-006 Judge whether a set can be built from, and report the gaps (delegable to an agent)
b>TR-007 Decide the domain's own terms, and what each one means (never delegated)
b>TR-008 Decide the interview on a section is finished (never delegated)
b>TR-009 Decide a section may be left at draft and moved on from (never delegated)
b>TR-010 Decide the set may be offered for approval (never delegated)
b>TR-011 Decide a backlog can be mapped from the set (delegable to an agent)
b>TR-012 Decide which epics come first (never delegated)
b>TR-013 Accept a drafted section as saying what the expert meant, or correct it (never delegated)
b>TR-014 Accept or refute a section's score (never delegated)
b>TR-015 Turn off a set's outbound domain research (never delegated)
